fnol_text: My name is Hannah McBride and I live at 165 Sycamore Street, Milton, VT 05497. You can reach me on (555) 339-6971 or hannah.mcbride@example.com. On 2 April 2025 I tried to drive through a flooded road under the bridge. The water was deeper than I thought and the engine cut out and filled with water. Policy MT-2024-00071. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr McBride on (555) 339-6971 to acknowledge the claim. Hannah confirmed the loss date as 2 April 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Chloe Kowalski gave a statement by phone.
Hannah sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
